name: How long does split siding repair take?

mainEntity.name: How long does split siding repair take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of split siding repair depends on the extent of the damage, the type of siding material, and accessibility. A small, isolated split might take a few hours to patch and seal. More extensive repairs involving multiple panel replacements can take one to two days. Factors like weather conditions and the need to source specific matching materials can also influence the timeline.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair time varies from a few hours for minor splits to one to two days for extensive damage, depending on material and accessibility.
